name: Ambodo: Co-Parenting
subtitle: Calm talk. Fair plans. Proof.
promo: One plan covers both homes. ToneGuard keeps messages calm, the custody calendar keeps everyone on the same page, and every record is sealed and court-ready.
short: Co-parent calmly: sealed messages, one custody calendar, court-ready records.
body:
Two homes. One team.

Ambodo keeps co-parenting calm, fair and on the record — for both of you, on one family plan.

• Talk calm — ToneGuard checks every message before it lands and offers a kinder version. Every message is sealed to the one before it, so history can't be quietly edited.
• Plan fair — one custody calendar you both see the same way. 2-2-3, week on/week off, 2-2-5-5 and more. Swap days in two taps; nothing changes until you both agree.
• Keep proof — handoff check-ins, shared expenses and swap history, exported as a court-ready PDF with seal verification.
• Know the kids — school, doctor, allergies and sizes in one shared place.
• Sync everywhere — custody days in Apple or Google Calendar.

Free: set up your family space with one kid's profile, the custody schedule and handoff check-ins.
Ambodo Family (one plan for both parents, monthly or yearly): connect your co-parent for sealed messages, shared events and swap requests, add all your kids, court-ready PDF records, expenses and settle-ups, calendar sync and unlimited ToneGuard rewrites. Fee waivers are available for families who need them.
payApple: Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.
payPlay: Payment is charged to your Google Play account. The subscription renews automatically until you cancel; manage or cancel any time in Google Play → Payments & subscriptions.
whatsNewApple: Ambodo now speaks your language: 75 languages that follow your phone's settings, with dates and amounts written the way you write them. Also new: set up your family first, then create your account at the end.
whatsNewPlay: Ambodo now speaks your language: 75 languages that follow your phone's settings, with dates and amounts written the way you write them.
subMonthlyDesc: One plan for both homes, billed monthly.
subYearlyDesc: One plan for both homes, billed yearly.
